title: Live DOM and accessibility observation
objective: Bind the existing browser snapshot/observation contract to live DOM and accessibility evidence from the governed browser host while preserving exact page/origin/generation identity, bounds, stale failure, password/secret redaction, and the denial of arbitrary JavaScript, raw CDP, personal-profile data, and browser credential stores.

include: live DOM and accessibility-tree reads for one known active Quntal page
server-issued browser node identities bound to profile, page, page generation, origin, document generation, role/state/index, workspace, and policy revision
max_nodes, max_depth, max_bytes, response-size, timeout, and image-free structured observation bounds
password/secret field value redaction and exclusion of cookies, storage, credentials, tokens, autofill stores, and personal profile state
document-generation advancement and deterministic invalidation after navigation/document replacement
tests for forged/stale/cross-page/cross-origin/cross-workspace/cross-policy node identities, oversized trees, hidden secret fields, shadow DOM/iframe boundaries, and dynamic document mutation

authority_delta.process: None beyond prior browser host authority.
authority_delta.network: None beyond SG-000075 mediated browser loading.
authority_delta.browser: Read-only live DOM/accessibility observation is added for already-authorized live pages.
authority_delta.secrets: No password, cookie, token, credential, storage secret, or personal-profile data may enter observation results/evidence/logs.
authority_delta.approval: No new mutation approval; observation remains bounded read authority under the existing page/workspace/profile contract.

invariants: browser node identities are server allocated and stale on page/document drift
raw JavaScript/CDP and browser stores remain unreachable
no silent actuation or coordinate fallback occurs

acceptance.claim: A real loaded page produces a bounded live DOM/accessibility snapshot whose node IDs are exactly bound to the Quntal page/origin/document generations.
Stale, forged, cross-page, cross-origin, cross-workspace, replaced-document, and policy-drift identities fail closed.
Password/secret values, cookies, credentials, tokens, storage, autofill, and personal-profile data are absent from results, audit payloads, and logs.
Arbitrary JS/CDP, actuation, transfer, screenshot, coordinate, personal-profile, and remote authority remain unreachable.
Exact-head live-browser tests, CI, TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, security review, and zero unresolved blockers pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000077: Live browser actuation may activate only after live node identity and stale semantics are canonically qualified.

done_when: Live structured browser observation is canonically qualified with exact node identity, deterministic bounds, secret minimization, and no raw browser debugging/scripting reach.
